name: Scarlet Monastery

entrance.note: Northeast Tirisfal monastery courtyard. Four wing portals inside the building (left to right per Wowhead Classic: Graveyard, Cathedral, Armory, Library). Armory and Cathedral doors need The Scarlet Key from Library. steps-v2 run goto is mapId 1420 at 82.6, 33.8.

travel.how: Fly Michael Garrett in Undercity (63.25, 48.56) or walk east from Brill through Tirisfal to 82.6, 33.8. From Tarren Mill, run north through the river/Undercity elevator then east. Horde pickup is Brill / Undercity / the courtyard — do not send the player to Stormwind or Southshore.

quests.name: Test of Faith
quests.notes: Prerequisite chain start (leap of faith). Catalog balanced-only. No SM step ids. Take it when already in Thousand Needles. Leads to 1150.

quests.name: Test of Endurance
quests.notes: Grenka's Claw, outside the dungeon. Catalog speedrun:true as a chain unlock. No SM step ids. Leads to 1151.

quests.name: Test of Strength
quests.notes: Fragments of Rok'Alim, outside. Catalog speedrun:false. Leads to 1152.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.notes: Travel handoff Thousand Needles -> Braug Dimspirit at Talondeep Path. Catalog speedrun:false. Leads to 1154.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.notes: Legacy of the Aspects, outside SM. Catalog speedrun:false. Leads to 6627.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.notes: Riddle at Braug. Catalog speedrun:false. Leads to 1159. Catalog table lists 1159 before 6627; QuestieDB order is 1154 -> 6627 -> 1159.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.notes: Travel Braug -> Parqual Fintallas in Undercity (57.8, 65.42 in questie-db). Catalog speedrun:false. Unlocks dungeon step 1160.

quests.name: Vorrel's Revenge
quests.notes: Pick up from Vorrel inside Graveyard (no outdoor coords). Wedding ring 5538 drops from Nancy Vishas in Alterac Mountains 32.33, 32.78 (questie-db) — outside the instance. Turn in at Tarren Mill, not Stormwind. Catalog speedrun:false (extra travel). Rewards: Grimsteel Cape, Mantle of Woe, Vorrel's Boots.

quests.name: Hearts of Zeal
quests.notes: 20 Hearts of Zeal from Scarlet humanoids in any wing (Loksey, Herod, Mograine, Whitemane, Vishas, Sentries, etc.). Requires Going, Going, Guano! 1109 from Razorfen Kraul / Faranell. Run every wing once; do not reset a wing for more hearts. Catalog speedrun:true.

quests.name: Test of Lore
quests.notes: Dungeon book Beginnings of the Undead Threat (5861) in Library. No dedicated accept/turnin steps; the run step collects it. Catalog marks insideDungeon:false (conflict). speedrun:false. Leads to 6628 (Undercity riddle, not in this catalog).

quests.name: Compendium of the Fallen
quests.notes: Library book Compendium of the Fallen (5535). steps-v2 race filter Orc/Tauren/Troll; questie-db races 162. Catalog marks insideDungeon:false (conflict with README Library). Rewards: Vile Protector, Omega Orb, Forcestone Buckler. Worth it if Thunder Bluff hearth/pass-through.

quests.name: Into The Scarlet Monastery
quests.notes: Kill Houndmaster Loksey (Library), Herod (Armory), Scarlet Commander Mograine and High Inquisitor Whitemane (Cathedral). Pickup is Varimathras in Undercity, not Stormwind. Catalog speedrun:true (5150 base). Rewards: Sword of Omen, Prophetic Cane, Dragon's Blood Necklace.

keys.name: The Scarlet Key
keys.from: Chest behind Arcanist Doan, Library (Wowhead Classic strategy guide)
keys.notes: Classic courtyard doors: Graveyard and Library open; Armory and Cathedral locked until this key. Not present in content/questie-db items.json Forever import — do not invent an item id. Clear Library before Armory/Cathedral if the group has no key.

prep.group: 5-player. Overall 26-45; runAt 29 is for Graveyard. Suggested wing order and bands (Wowhead Classic zone page): Graveyard 26-36 at ~29, Library 29-39 at ~32, Armory 32-42 at ~35, Cathedral 35-45 at ~38. Do not combine SM with another instance.
warnings: Horde pickup is Brill / Undercity / the SM courtyard. Do not send the player to Stormwind (Alliance Into the Scarlet Monastery is a different quest and is not in the Horde catalog).
Run order: Graveyard (Vorrel + hearts) -> Library (Compendium, Test of Lore book, Loksey, Scarlet Key) -> Armory (Herod) -> Cathedral (Mograine + Whitemane). Armory/Cathedral need the Library key.
Scarlet humanoids flee at low health; stop runners from chaining the next room.
Run every wing once. Do not reset a wing for more Hearts of Zeal.
Hearts of Zeal 1113 requires RFK quest 1109 (Going, Going, Guano!) at Faranell first.
Vorrel's ring is from Nancy Vishas in Alterac (32.33, 32.78), then Tarren Mill — not inside Graveyard.
Compendium 1049 is Orc/Tauren/Troll only; Undead skip it.
At most five dungeon entries/resets per hour. Forever hotfix: dungeon kill XP +50%; if any member is greying the mobs, nobody gets XP.

classQuests.name: Rituals of Power
classQuests.notes: In content/questie-db (classes 128, pre 1950, Tabetha/Dustwallow turn-in via NPC 6546). Book is the Classic SM Library mage quest. Not in dungeons.json SM list and not in steps-v2 — do not invent a dungeon-pack step.

speedrunReplaceCandidates.why: 20-40 dungeons-off for SM is Hammerfall / Thousand Needles / Desolace. Call to Arms and Guile of the Raptor are the long Hammerfall kill loops in the Library-to-Cathedral band.
Same dungeons-off replacement. Pacify the Centaur plus the Shimmering Flats part/venom/shell collect loop is the slow Needles XP a Graveyard/Library run replaces.
Same dungeons-off replacement. Bone Collector and Centaur Bounty are the long kodo-graveyard / centaur-kill farms in the Armory-Cathedral band.

sourceConflicts: Catalog 1049 and 1160 mark the Library books insideDungeon:false; README wings, the run-step collect actions, and Wowhead Classic treat both books as inside Library.

Wowhead Classic zone page / strategy guide: Graveyard 26-36, Library 29-39, Armory 32-42, Cathedral 35-45. Wowhead Classic Dungeons Overview also lists Graveyard 28-38. Warcraft Tavern: Graveyard 26-35, Library 30-40. Catalog overall range is 26-45.
The Scarlet Key for Armory/Cathedral is in Wowhead Classic guides; it is not in the Forever questie-db items import, so itemId is left null.
Test of Lore 1149-1159/6627 have no dungeons:scarlet-monastery step ids. 1160 is collected on the run step but has no accept/turnin steps.
Catalog table order lists 1159 before 6627; QuestieDB next-chain is 1154 -> 6627 -> 1159 -> 1160.
Classic Era XP in dungeons.json / questie-db; catalog notes Forever may halve dungeon-quest bonus XP (unofficial).
notes: Horde-only pack (Alliance 1050/1053 are absent from the Horde questie-db import). Pickup hub: Undercity and Brill, levels 30-40. Wings at different levels — do Graveyard first at runAt 29, then Library, then keyed Armory+Cathedral. Dungeons-off: Arathi (Hammerfall), Thousand Needles and Desolace. One quested pass per wing; do not reset-farm hearts. XP figures are Classic Era from dungeons.json / questie-db.
